text: At step 4000, trained distance R2 at layer 1 is about the same at N=128 (0.907-0.919) and N=256 (0.897-0.920), but trained force R2 is 0.08-0.10 lower at N=256. Is the matched-loss force shortfall specific to the m2 or 1/r^2 nonlinearity rather than to distance? Does a residualised force target (distance regressed out) show the same N=128 vs N=256 gap?
